`--input`

The query data to transfer the labels to. Should be a .h5mu file.

`--modality`

Which modality to use.

[Default]{.arg-key} `"rna"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obsm_features`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The `.obsm` key of the embedding to use for the classifier's inference. If not provided, the `.X` slot will be used instead.
Make sure that embedding was obtained in the same way as the reference embedding (e.g. by the same model or preprocessing).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"X_scvi"`
:::

### Outputs

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description

Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The query data in .h5mu format with predicted labels transferred from the reference.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted information.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_pred"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_probability`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predictions.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_probability"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/labels_transfer/cellmapper/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/labels_transfer/cellmapper);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/labels_transfer/cellmapper/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
